svg.title: Automated source retrieval — uncertainty is not disappearance
svg.desc: From 90 source entrances, 63 returned readable HTML, 2 returned PDFs, 3 returned limited interactive shells and 22 returned other inconclusive access results. These are retrieval-client results, not confirmed broken records.
svg.text: A failed click is not a missing archive.
